_brand_structure_doc: Per DR-032 Locked 2026-05-25. Two valid values: 'monolithic' (DEFAULT — 1 brand = 1 WP site, no center subdivision; 90%+ of EYWA portfolio) | 'multi_center' (1 brand = umbrella + N productized centers as URL subdirectories on single WP site; first adopter: vitality-hospital). See EYWA_HANDOVER.md v1.18 Note for decision criteria + NEW_BRAND_BOOTSTRAP.md Step 1.5 for the upfront decision.
_centers_doc: Required and populated ONLY when brand_structure='multi_center'; leave as [] for monolithic brands. Each center object: { center_slug, center_name_th, center_name_en, url_segment, positioning_one_line, flagship_programs[], indicative_pricing_thb, anchor_outcome, key_devices[], signature_tm[], position_order, status }. See eywa-vitality-hospital/brand-config.json for the canonical 7-center example.
_parent_network_doc: Optional. Populated when this brand belongs to a parent network/group (e.g., Vertex Hospital). Object shape: { network_name, network_role, sister_brands_in_network[], shared_data_spine }. Only relevant for brands inside a federation network (often paired with multi_center). See eywa-vitality-hospital/brand-config.json for example.
